parsed_response.explanation: The agent incorrectly interpreted the question 'Did any children below the age of 18 survive?' as 'Did all children below the age of 18 survive?'. This led to an incorrect conclusion based on the data.
parsed_response.evidence: The question was 'Did any children below the age of 18 survive?'. The agent calculated 'num_children_did_not_survive = 64' and concluded 'Since there are 64 children under the age of 18 who did not survive, this means that not all children under 18 survived.' and then answered 'No'. This indicates a misunderstanding of 'any' versus 'all'.
